reports.title: Law No. 35 of 1960 concerning Statistics and Censuses (as amended)
reports.publisher: Arab Republic of Egypt (Presidency / Legislature)
reports.description: Foundational legal instrument governing the conduct of statistics and censuses in Egypt. Establishes the framework for official statistical work, confidentiality of individual data, obligations to supply data, and coordination of statistical operations. Amended by Law No. 28 of 1982. Remains the primary statutory basis for official statistics production and is repeatedly cited in CAPMAS publications and data-access policies.
reports.cadence_note: One-off / amending legal instrument; still in force as the core statistics statute

reports.title: Presidential Decree No. 2915 of 1964 establishing the Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.publisher: Arab Republic of Egypt (Presidency of the Republic)
reports.description: Presidential Decree establishing the Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) as an independent authority adjunct to the Presidency of the Republic. Assigns CAPMAS the technical jurisdictions under Law No. 35 of 1960, including the power to conduct statistics and censuses required by the State, set dates and methods, disseminate results, and ensure coordination. Foundational institutional instrument for the Egyptian national statistical system.
reports.cadence_note: One-off founding decree; still the organisational foundation of CAPMAS

reports.title: Egypt Statistical Yearbook (كتاب الإحصاء السنوي)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Long-running comprehensive annual statistical yearbook published by CAPMAS. Presents detailed multi-domain national statistics covering population and demography, labour force, national accounts and prices, agriculture, industry, trade, education, health, transport, environment and related fields. Principal single-volume official reference for Egyptian official statistics; typically released around September–December.

reports.title: Egypt in Figures (مصر في أرقام)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Annual concise statistical booklet issued by CAPMAS presenting key demographic, social and economic indicators for Egypt in a compact format with recent time series and governorate highlights. Complements the more detailed Statistical Yearbook; typically released mid-year. Serves as a rapid-reference official summary for decision-makers and the public.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI) – Egypt (الرقم القياسي لأسعار المستهلكين)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Official Consumer Price Index and related inflation statistics for Egypt, compiled monthly by CAPMAS. Covers urban, rural and national series; primary official measure of consumer price inflation used for monetary-policy monitoring, living-standards analysis and indexation. Weights derive from household expenditure surveys. Monthly press releases and detailed bulletins are issued.

reports.title: Population and Housing Census of Egypt / General Census of Population, Housing and Establishments
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Decennial (or periodic) Population and Housing Census of Egypt, most recently conducted in 2017 as the General Census of Population, Housing and Establishments. Provides the official population base, demographic structure, housing characteristics and establishment counts. Subsequent annual population estimates and projections published by CAPMAS are derived from the census framework updated with vital registration (births and deaths).
reports.cadence_note: Decennial census with continuous inter-censal population estimates and projections

reports.title: Labour Force Survey / Quarterly Labour Force Survey (بحث القوى العاملة)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Official quarterly (and annual) labour-force statistics produced by CAPMAS. Provides nationally representative data on labour-force participation, employment, unemployment, underemployment and related indicators by sex, age, urban/rural residence and governorate. Principal official source for unemployment rates and labour-market analysis in Egypt; results released quarterly with annual summaries.

reports.title: Household Income, Expenditure and Consumption Survey (HIECS / بحث الدخل والإنفاق والاستهلاك)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Periodic large-scale household survey programme producing detailed statistics on household income, expenditure, consumption patterns, living standards and poverty. Conducted roughly every two years (recent rounds include 2017/18, 2019/20, 2021/22). Provides the micro-data foundation for CPI weights, poverty measurement, inequality analysis and national-accounts household consumption estimates.
reports.cadence_note: Approximately every two years (multi-wave field collection)

reports.title: Egypt National Accounts / GDP Statistics (Ministry of Planning series)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation (MPED)
reports.description: Official national accounts and GDP statistics for Egypt, compiled and disseminated primarily by the Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation (MPED). Includes GDP by production (value added by economic activity at factor cost) and expenditure approaches at current and constant prices, quarterly and annual series, and regional/governorate accounts. CAPMAS contributes source data and maintains related supply-use tables; the consolidated national-accounts responsibility has rested with MPED since the late 1990s. Core macroeconomic measure of economic activity and growth.
reports.cadence_note: Quarterly releases with annual final estimates; base-year revisions periodically

reports.title: Central Bank of Egypt Monthly Statistical Bulletin
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE)
reports.description: Flagship monthly statistical publication of the Central Bank of Egypt. Compiles and disseminates comprehensive monetary, banking, fiscal, external-sector and selected real-sector statistics, including reserve money, domestic liquidity (M2), credit, interest rates, international reserves, exchange rates, balance of payments summaries, and selected CAPMAS/MPED indicators (CPI, GDP). Primary official source for high-frequency monetary and external statistics.

reports.title: Central Bank of Egypt Balance of Payments and External Sector Statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE)
reports.description: Official Balance of Payments, International Investment Position, external debt and related external-sector statistics compiled by the Central Bank of Egypt in accordance with IMF standards (BPM6). Covers the current account (goods, services including Suez Canal, income, transfers), capital and financial accounts, reserve assets and external debt. Disseminated through the Monthly Statistical Bulletin, dedicated BoP releases, SDDS and the Annual Report. Primary official source for Egypt’s external accounts.
reports.cadence_note: Quarterly BoP with monthly reserves and related indicators

reports.title: Producer Price Index (PPI) – Egypt (الأرقام القياسية لأسعار المنتجين)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Official monthly Producer Price Index compiled by CAPMAS covering agriculture, forestry & fishing, mining & quarrying, manufacturing, electricity & gas, water supply, construction, and selected service activities (including accommodation and food services). Base year January 2016 = 100 (updated series). Primary official measure of producer-level price change used for national-accounts deflation and inflation analysis alongside the CPI.

reports.title: Annual Agricultural Statistics / Crop Area and Plant Production / Agricultural Income Estimates
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Annual CAPMAS bulletins on cultivated and cropped areas, plant production quantities and values, agricultural income estimates, and related farm-gate statistics. Covers major field crops (wheat, rice, maize, potatoes, tomatoes, etc.), permanent crops, and value of agricultural production by component (plant, animal, fish). Core source for the agriculture sector contribution to GDP and food-security indicators.

reports.title: Annual Livestock Statistics (إحصاءات الثروة الحيوانية)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Annual CAPMAS bulletin on livestock numbers (cattle, buffalo, sheep, goats, camels), slaughtered animals, red-meat production, milk production, poultry meat and egg output. Complements plant-production statistics and feeds the animal-production component of agricultural income and GDP by activity.

reports.title: Foreign Trade Statistics / Merchandise Trade (إحصاءات التجارة الخارجية)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Official merchandise trade statistics compiled by CAPMAS from customs declarations. Covers exports and imports by commodity group, partner country, and economic use; published in monthly and annual bulletins. Primary customs-based trade series used alongside the banking-based trade figures that appear in the CBE Balance of Payments.

reports.title: Tourism Statistics / Tourist Arrivals and Nights (إحصاءات السياحة)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) / Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
reports.description: Official statistics on inbound tourist arrivals, tourist nights, and related tourism indicators. CAPMAS publishes tourism data series and integrates them into the Statistical Yearbook; the Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities and CBE also report tourism receipts that feed the services account of the Balance of Payments. Key sector for services exports and employment.

reports.title: Industrial / Total Production Index components (Manufacturing, Electricity, Construction, Tourism, etc.)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation (MPED) / CAPMAS
reports.description: Short-term production indices covering manufacturing, natural gas, oil products, electricity, construction, transportation (including Suez Canal), and tourism. Compiled and disseminated under the national accounts / real-sector monitoring framework; used as high-frequency indicators of sectoral activity that feed into quarterly GDP estimates.

reports.title: Energy / Petroleum and Electricity Production Statistics
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) / relevant energy authorities
reports.description: Official statistics on petroleum (crude and products), natural gas, and electricity production and related energy indicators that appear in CAPMAS yearbooks and specialised bulletins and feed the extractive and utilities components of national accounts and the PPI.
reports.cadence_note: Annual aggregates with higher-frequency production indices

reports.title: GDP / Gross Regional Product by Governorate (National Accounts – Regional)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation (MPED)
reports.description: Official estimates of GDP (value added) by governorate and economic region produced within the national accounts framework. Provides the principal measure of economic size and structure at subnational level and the vertical link from governorate activity into national GDP.

reports.title: Population Estimates by Governorate
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Annual mid-year or 1 January population estimates by governorate derived from the 2017 Population and Housing Census updated with vital registration (births and deaths). Core demographic base for all governorate-level analysis and for weighting of national surveys.
reports.cadence_note: Annual estimates; continuous population clock on CAPMAS site

reports.title: Cairo Governorate Statistical Profile / Key Indicators
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) / Cairo Governorate
reports.description: Aggregated official statistics for Cairo Governorate drawn from CAPMAS national products (population estimates, labour force, household surveys) and governorate-level administrative data. Cairo is the largest governorate by population and a major contributor to national GDP; serves as the core metropolitan node.
reports.cadence_note: Annual / continuous updates via national series

reports.title: Giza Governorate Statistical Profile / Key Indicators
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) / Giza Governorate
reports.description: Aggregated official statistics for Giza Governorate. Second-largest by population and integral to Greater Cairo; includes significant industrial, residential and tourist (Pyramids) activity. Provides metropolitan contrast to pure urban Cairo.
reports.cadence_note: Annual / continuous updates via national series

reports.title: Alexandria Governorate Statistical Profile / Key Indicators
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) / Alexandria Governorate
reports.description: Aggregated official statistics for Alexandria Governorate, Egypt’s principal Mediterranean port and second major metropolitan centre after Greater Cairo. Captures coastal / port-city economic structure (trade, industry, services).
reports.cadence_note: Annual / continuous updates via national series

reports.title: Minya Governorate Statistical Profile / Key Indicators (Upper Egypt contrast)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Aggregated official statistics for Minya Governorate in Upper Egypt. Provides inland / Upper Egypt demographic and economic contrast to the coastal and Greater Cairo metropolitan governorates; significant agricultural base.
reports.cadence_note: Annual / continuous updates via national series

reports.title: Sohag Governorate Statistical Profile / Key Indicators (Upper Egypt contrast)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Aggregated official statistics for Sohag Governorate in Upper Egypt. Complements Minya as a second Upper Egypt contrast node with substantial rural and agricultural population.
reports.cadence_note: Annual / continuous updates via national series

reports.title: Aswan Governorate Statistical Profile / Key Indicators (Upper Egypt / frontier contrast)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Aggregated official statistics for Aswan Governorate at the southern end of the Nile Valley. Serves as Upper Egypt / frontier contrast (tourism, High Dam, lower population density relative to Delta and Cairo).
reports.cadence_note: Annual / continuous updates via national series

reports.title: Ministry of Finance Financial Monthly Bulletin / Fiscal Performance Statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance (MoF)
reports.description: Monthly fiscal bulletin published by the Ministry of Finance presenting budget execution (revenues, expenditures by economic and functional classification), overall and primary balance, domestic and external financing, and related public-finance indicators. Primary official high-frequency source for Egypt’s fiscal accounts; data also feed CBE monetary and below-the-line analysis.

reports.title: State Budget / Final Accounts (الموازنة العامة / الحساب الختامي)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance (MoF)
reports.description: Annual State Budget law and subsequent Final Accounts (approved by Parliament) presenting the full fiscal framework: revenues, expenditures by economic and functional classification, deficit/surplus, and financing. Constitutional targets for health, education and scientific research spending are monitored against these accounts. CAPMAS also issues a related annual bulletin on public expenditure drawn from MoF sources.

reports.title: Education Statistics (Pre-university and Higher Education)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) / Ministry of Education and Technical Education / Ministry of Higher Education
reports.description: Official statistics on pre-university education (schools, classes, pupils, teachers) and higher education (enrolment, graduates by type of institution). Published in CAPMAS specialised bulletins and the Statistical Yearbook; primary source for education indicators used in human-development and labour-force analysis.

reports.title: Egypt Family Health Survey / Demographic and Health Indicators
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) / Ministry of Health and Population
reports.description: Periodic large-scale household survey programme (Egypt Family Health Survey / related DHS-style rounds) producing fertility, maternal and child health, nutrition, family-planning and related demographic-health indicators. Most recent major round referenced around 2021; results feed population projections, health policy and the Statistical Yearbook.

reports.title: Health Statistics / Health Facilities and Services Indicators
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) / Ministry of Health and Population
reports.description: Official statistics on health facilities, hospital beds, medical personnel, selected service utilisation and related indicators published by CAPMAS in specialised bulletins and the Statistical Yearbook. Complements the Family Health Survey micro-data with administrative health-system statistics.

reports.title: Vital Statistics (Births, Deaths, Marriage, Divorce)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Official civil-registration-based statistics on births, deaths, marriages and divorces. Used to update inter-censal population estimates and to compile crude rates that appear in the Statistical Yearbook and Egypt in Figures.

reports.title: Egypt / CAPMAS Contribution to BRICS Joint Statistical Publication and NSO Cooperation
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Thin institutional contribution node representing Egypt’s provision of national statistical series (national accounts, prices, population, labour, external trade, etc.) to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication (JSP) and related BRICS National Statistical Offices cooperation mechanisms (Heads of NSOs meetings, technical working groups). Egypt joined BRICS as a full member in 2024; CAPMAS participates in the statistics track (including the 2026 Lucknow NSO Heads meeting). No separate freestanding titled annual ‘Egypt BRICS Statistical Report’ is required; the contribution is evidenced by data appearing in successive JSP editions and by CAPMAS public statements on BRICS statistical cooperation.
reports.cadence_note: Aligned with BRICS JSP and NSO meeting cycle

reports.title: CAPMAS Study: Egypt and the BRICS Countries (2013–2024 / subsequent updates)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Analytical statistical study issued by CAPMAS examining trade, investment and selected economic indicators between Egypt and BRICS member states over a multi-year window (explicitly referenced for 2013–2024 with later updates). Provides tabulated trade values, partner rankings and growth rates; supports public communication of Egypt’s BRICS economic engagement. Complements the regular foreign-trade bulletins.

reports.title: Annual Bulletin of Water Purification and Sanitation Statistics (النشرة السنوية لإحصاءات المياه النقية والصرف الصحي)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Annual CAPMAS bulletin on potable water production, distribution networks, sanitation/sewerage coverage, treatment plants and related service indicators by governorate. Primary official source for water and sanitation access and infrastructure statistics used in living-standards, health and environmental analysis.

reports.title: Bulletin of Housing in Egypt / Housing Units Statistics (نشرة الإسكان في مصر)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Annual CAPMAS bulletin on housing units executed by public, public-business and private sectors, investments in housing, new-city projects and related residential construction indicators. Provides the principal official measure of housing supply and is used for urban-policy and construction-sector analysis.

reports.title: Construction and Building Statistics / Construction Sector Indicators
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) / Ministry of Planning
reports.description: Official statistics on construction activity, building permits or completed works, and the construction component of GDP and investment. Complements the Housing bulletin with broader construction-sector coverage that feeds national accounts and the industrial/production index framework.

reports.title: Annual Bulletin of Vehicles and Trains Accidents / Transport Safety Statistics
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Annual CAPMAS bulletin on road-vehicle and railway accidents, casualties and related transport-safety indicators. Complements broader transport and warehousing statistics that appear in national accounts and the Statistical Yearbook.

reports.title: Annual Bulletin of Transportation Means of Petroleum Products and Natural Gas
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Annual CAPMAS bulletin covering transport modes and volumes for petroleum products and natural gas. Links energy production statistics to the transport and logistics component of the economy.

reports.title: Quarterly Industrial Production Statistics / Manufacturing Production Index (إحصاء الإنتاج الصناعي الربع سنوي)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Quarterly CAPMAS statistics on industrial production covering public/public-business and private-sector establishments. Provides short-term indicators of manufacturing output, employment and related variables that feed the monthly/annual industrial production index and quarterly GDP estimates.

reports.title: Economic Census of Egypt (التعداد الاقتصادي)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Periodic Economic Census enumerating establishments by economic activity, employment size, legal form and geographic location. Provides the structural baseline for industrial, trade and services statistics, sample frames for enterprise surveys, and detailed activity-level data used in national accounts and productivity analysis. Most recent major rounds referenced in the 2010s–2020s programme.

reports.title: Poverty Statistics / National and Multidimensional Poverty Indicators (from HIECS)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) / Ministry of Planning / Ministry of Social Solidarity
reports.description: Official poverty measurement programme based primarily on the Household Income, Expenditure and Consumption Survey (HIECS). Includes monetary poverty rates (national poverty line) and the national Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) developed with partners (dimensions covering education, health, housing, services, employment, social protection and food security). Primary official source for poverty incidence, depth and regional disparities.
reports.cadence_note: Aligned with HIECS rounds (approximately every two years) plus periodic MPI analytical releases

reports.title: Dakahlia Governorate Statistical Profile / Key Indicators (Delta contrast)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Aggregated official statistics for Dakahlia Governorate in the Nile Delta. Provides Lower Egypt / Delta agricultural and demographic contrast to the metropolitan (Cairo/Giza/Alexandria) and Upper Egypt nodes already covered.
reports.cadence_note: Annual / continuous updates via national series

reports.title: Sharqia Governorate Statistical Profile / Key Indicators (Delta contrast)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Aggregated official statistics for Sharqia (Sharkia) Governorate in the eastern Delta. Complements Dakahlia as a second major Delta agricultural/population node.
reports.cadence_note: Annual / continuous updates via national series

reports.title: Qalyubia Governorate Statistical Profile / Key Indicators (Greater Cairo periphery)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Aggregated official statistics for Qalyubia Governorate, immediately north of Cairo and part of the broader Greater Cairo economic zone. Provides peri-urban / industrial-agricultural contrast within the metropolitan system.
reports.cadence_note: Annual / continuous updates via national series

reports.title: Annual Bulletin of Patents and Trademarks Statistics (النشرة السنوية لبراءات الاختراع والعلامات التجارية)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Annual CAPMAS bulletin on patents granted, trademark registrations and related intellectual-property indicators. Thin but real official series supporting innovation and business-environment analysis; appears in the Statistical Yearbook and specialised releases.

reports.title: CAPMAS Monthly Informatics Bulletin (النشرة المعلوماتية)
reports.publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
reports.description: Monthly concise statistical bulletin issued by CAPMAS presenting the latest available indicators across key demographic, social and economic domains in a compact, graph-supported format. Serves as a rapid-update companion to the more comprehensive Statistical Yearbook and specialised annual bulletins.
